interface.name: nt_plasma_foreign_surface_manager_v1
interface.description: The manager is advertised by the NT-Plasma compositor bridge. A desktop client uses it to present a Windows application surface inside the KDE desktop. The host remains responsible for the native process and window.

interface.name: nt_plasma_foreign_surface_v1
interface.description: A foreign surface has an immutable window identity. The compositor controls placement and input routing; the host controls capture and native window lifetime.

request.name: attach_frame

description.summary: Attach a frame for compositor presentation

request.description: The buffer must use the compositor's negotiated format and dimensions. The frame sequence is strictly increasing.
